race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
race.verdict: AURADUE has fewer miles on the clock than her opposition here and she can defy a 4 lb rise to follow up from last month's Southwell success. Pivotal Terms went down by just a neck there and is respected meeting the selection on better terms, whilst Spun To Gold is interesting from this mark on his second outing after a break. AURADUE PIVOTAL TERMS SPUN TO GOLD (USA)
